rows.bestPlan: The stock strong-player build: Town Greeter, Overlord of the Balemurk and Winternight Stories flood the graveyard, then Superior Spider-Man enters as a copy of a milled Bringer of the Last Gift for four mana (it was cast, so the trigger fires), wiping the board and reanimating everything you milled while Ghost Vacuum keeps the opponent's yard empty.

Creature-dense midrange where Bringer is a one-sided reset button: cheap ETB bodies and Enduring creatures stay on board, Ghost Vacuum strips the opponent's graveyard, and when Bringer (hardcast or copied by Spider-Man) resolves every Greeter, Siren, Drowner and Bat comes back and re-triggers while Enduring cards return as enchantments.

Green ramp into giants: Elves, Greeter and Enduring Vitality power out a hardcast Bringer or Overlord of the Hauntwoods, while Winternight Stories and Bitter Triumph pitch Valgavoth, Koma and Regent so Superior Spider-Man can wear a nine-drop's body on turn four.

Tempo-oriented Oculus deck: Greeter, Siren and Cache Grab stock the graveyard for a turn-three Abhorrent Oculus, Superior Spider-Man copies Oculus without paying the exile cost, Flood Maw and Tidebinder protect the clock, and a couple of Bringers (via Spider-Man) give inevitability against sweepers.

Overlords-and-Beanstalk value: impending Overlords are enchantments so a hardcast Bringer only eats real creatures, then any Overlord Greeter milled or Floodpits discarded comes back as a full creature, Up the Beanstalk draws off every five-plus drop, and Spider-Man doubles as a cheap extra Bringer or Balemurk.

rows.bestPlan: Simic Landfall: Bristly Bill, Sazh's Chocobo and Mossborn Hydra grow with every land drop and Mightform Harmonizer turns each landfall counter into a team-wide pump, with Icetill Explorer and Traveling Chocobo providing extra land drops, Snakeskin Veil and Spell Snare protecting the engine from removal and cheap threats, and Full Bore delivering the trampling kill.

decks.plan: The stock strong-player build: Simic Ouroboroid counters with Llanowar Elves ramping into Ouroboroid and Mightform Harmonizer so every Innkeeper's Talent, Pawpatch Recruit or Ouroboroid counter snowballs across the board, with Spell Snare stopping Cauldron, Needlehead and Drowner and Full Bore pushing a huge trampler through blockers.

Temur Cauldron: Agatha's Soul Cauldron exiling creatures and Marauding Mako discards put +1/+1 counters that Mightform Harmonizer multiplies across Vivi and friends, while Spell Snare and Into the Flood Maw protect the engine and Full Bore turns a counter-laden Vivi or Mako into a lethal trampling swing.

Bant Skies counters: cheap evasive bodies like Spyglass Siren, Novice Inspector and Warden of the Inner Sky generate counters that Mightform Harmonizer spreads to the whole air force, Haliya and Cosmogrand Zenith provide reach, Spell Snare and Seam Rip handle Needlehead/Drowner/Cauldron, and Full Bore closes through a chump-blocker.

Sultai midrange: take the Dimir removal-and-card-advantage core of Floodpits Drowner, Preacher, Enduring Curiosity and Kaito, add Innkeeper's Talent and Mightform Harmonizer as a grindy counter-based top end that out-sizes opposing midrange, with Spell Snare and Full Bore as cheap interaction that doubles as a surprise lethal or fight-style blowout.

Simic Landfall: Bristly Bill, Sazh's Chocobo and Mossborn Hydra grow with every land drop and Mightform Harmonizer turns each landfall counter into a team-wide pump, with Icetill Explorer and Traveling Chocobo providing extra land drops, Snakeskin Veil and Spell Snare protecting the engine from removal and cheap threats, and Full Bore delivering the trampling kill.

rows.bestPlan: The stock strong-player build: a Selesnya counters shell where Bramble Familiar is a second Llanowar Elves that can reset itself to re-trigger Airbender Ascension, Ouroboroid and Innkeeper's Talent snowball counters, and Appa is the evasive, hard-to-answer top end that clears blockers and closes.

decks.plan: The stock strong-player build: a Selesnya counters shell where Bramble Familiar is a second Llanowar Elves that can reset itself to re-trigger Airbender Ascension, Ouroboroid and Innkeeper's Talent snowball counters, and Appa is the evasive, hard-to-answer top end that clears blockers and closes.

Bant bounce-tempo: Nurturing Pixie, Sunpearl Kirin and Bramble Familiar's self-return constantly send your own permanents back to hand to fire Airbender Ascension while Floodpits Drowner and Tidebinder tempo the opponent, and Appa re-buys the whole engine from the air.

Abzan Fetch Quest reanimator: Bramble Familiar ramps early and later bounces itself so its adventure side can dig Bringer of the Last Gift or Overlord of the Balemurk straight out of the library, with Awaken the Honored Dead and Superior Spider-Man as redundant cheat effects and Appa plus Ascension as a fair, bounce-resistant backup plan.

Naya aggro-tempo: cheap red and green beaters put the opponent on a clock, Bramble Familiar accelerates into Appa a turn early, Airbender Ascension turns every bounce into pressure, and burn plus Witchstalker Frenzy clear the way so Appa's airbending removes the last blocker.

Bant ramp-control: Bramble Familiar and Llanowar Elves jump into Marang River Regent and Kona, Rescue Beastie, whose enter-the-battlefield returns re-trigger Airbender Ascension on your own permanents, while Stock Up, Get Lost and counterspells buy time until Appa and the Regent dominate the air against the Dimir and Cauldron decks.

rows.bestPlan: Jeskai spells-matter: every Lesson is a cheap noncreature spell that grows Vivi Ornitier, triggers Cori-Steel Cutter and Fear of Missing Out, and chains off Marauding Mako, so the burn doubles as removal and as fuel for an explosive prowess-style turn.

decks.plan: The metagame-default Boros aggro build: curve out with Hired Claw, Emberheart Challenger and Heartfire Hero, use Firebending Lesson and Combustion Technique as cheap burn that clears Floodpits Drowner and Razorkin Needlehead while pointing excess at face, and Abandon Attachments as the flexible white answer to Enduring Curiosity and Kaito before Screaming Nemesis closes.

Jeskai spells-matter: every Lesson is a cheap noncreature spell that grows Vivi Ornitier, triggers Cori-Steel Cutter and Fear of Missing Out, and chains off Marauding Mako, so the burn doubles as removal and as fuel for an explosive prowess-style turn.

Jeskai control that treats the Lessons as cheap sorcery-speed removal to recur: Shiko, Paragon of the Way rebuys Firebending Lesson or Abandon Attachments for free, Stock Up and Marang River Regent bury midrange in cards, and Combustion Technique plus Split Up punish go-wide starts before Beza and dragons stabilize.

Mardu midrange that grinds with Deep-Cavern Bat, Preacher of the Schism and Cecil, Dark Knight, uses the red Lessons and black removal to beat Dimir on card quality, and leans on Abandon Attachments plus Momentum Breaker to strip Enduring Curiosity, Kaito and Cauldron-style permanents that burn cannot touch.

Naya ramp-midrange that borrows the Ouroboroid shell: Llanowar Elves and Pawpatch Recruit accelerate into Ouroboroid and Innkeeper's Talent while the red Lessons clear blockers and Combustion Technique sweeps opposing token or Ouroboroid boards, with Abandon Attachments and Beza giving white interaction and lifegain against Izzet.

rows.bestPlan: The stock metagame build: curve one- and two-drop red threats, use Bounce Off and burn to clear blockers, and let Ashling, Rekindled turn leftover mana into reach while Sunderflock provides an evasive follow-up that dodges Lightning Helix-sized answers.

decks.plan: The stock metagame build: curve one- and two-drop red threats, use Bounce Off and burn to clear blockers, and let Ashling, Rekindled turn leftover mana into reach while Sunderflock provides an evasive follow-up that dodges Lightning Helix-sized answers.

Izzet spells-matter: chain cheap cantrips and burn to grow Ashling and trigger Cori-Steel Cutter and Stormchaser's Talent, with Bounce Off doubling as removal and a spell count, and Sunderflock as a resilient top-end that punishes sorcery-speed sweepers.

Gruul counters midrange borrowing the Landfall shell: Llanowar Elves ramps into Ashling and Sunderflock early, Innkeeper's Talent and Mightform Harmonizer multiply counters so Ashling's damage scales out of control, and Bounce Off keeps the board clear of Floodpits Drowner and Spyglass Siren.

Rakdos midrange that grinds with discard and removal, pairs Ashling with Fear of Missing Out and Screaming Nemesis as must-answer threats, and uses Sunderflock plus Bounce Off to beat the Simic Ouroboroid and Dimir boards through card-for-card trades.

Boros big-flyers midrange: Clarion Conqueror and cheap burn tax the Lessons and spell decks while Ashling grows into a late-game threat, then Sunderflock and the Hellkite dragons close in the air with Lightning Helix and Get Lost covering the ground.

rows.bestPlan: A mono-black self-deck combo: cast Excruciator to leave yourself six cards, then next turn impend Overlord of the Balemurk (mill five) plus Insatiable Avarice draw-three to empty your library and win on the following upkeep, with discard and removal buying time and Avarice's tutor mode finding the missing piece.

decks.plan: The meta build: a mono-black midrange shell that grinds with cheap removal and card advantage, uses Insatiable Avarice as a flexible draw-three or a tutor-to-top for Excruciator, and closes with a hardcast 6/6 flier that strips every answer out of the opponent's library.

Dimir control that strips hands and counters threats, then resolves Excruciator to shrink both libraries to six and points Insatiable Avarice at the opponent (draw three, lose three) so they deck out within a turn or two while Kaito and Enduring Curiosity keep your own hand full.

Golgari ramp-midrange that borrows the Llanowar Elves / Badgermole Cub / Ouroboroid engine to hit six mana fast, uses Insatiable Avarice as a one-mana tutor for Ouroboroid or Excruciator, and backs it with black's premium removal so the 6/6 flier arrives as an unanswerable top end.

Orzhov control that wipes the board and gains life until it can land Excruciator, which leaves the opponent six cards against a deck full of lifegain and spot removal, with Archenemy's Charm doubling as exile removal or a lifelink boost and Avarice refilling after a sweeper.

rows.bestPlan: Rakdos Monument discard-synergy: Monument to Endurance and Fear of Missing Out turn pitching Phoenix into card advantage since it comes back from the graveyard on its own once a Flail-equipped Elf gets to four power, with red lesson burn and Artist's Talent filling the deck with cheap fuel.

decks.plan: The stock aggro build: cheap red one-drops plus Iron-Shield Elf go wide early, Bloodthorn Flail turns any body into a 4-power threat that keeps Flamewake Phoenix recurring every combat, and burn closes against Simic and Landfall before they stabilize.

Jund Elves ramp: Llanowar Elves and Iron-Shield Elf accelerate into Badgermole Cub, Sentinel and Ouroboroid, whose naturally large bodies keep Phoenix's ferocious trigger live while the Flail lets the mana dorks swing as real threats late.

Mardu recursive midrange: Alesha, Cecil and Phoenix are threats that refuse to stay dead, the Flail and Iron-Shield Elf give the mobilize tokens and small bodies real combat value, and Lightning Helix plus Get Lost handle Izzet and Boros aggro.

Rakdos disruptive midrange in the Dimir mold: Deep-Cavern Bat and Preacher strip hands and grind cards, Iron-Shield Elf wearing a Flail is a cheap resilient attacker, and Phoenix gives a removal-proof recurring clock backed by the best black interaction.

Rakdos Monument discard-synergy: Monument to Endurance and Fear of Missing Out turn pitching Phoenix into card advantage since it comes back from the graveyard on its own once a Flail-equipped Elf gets to four power, with red lesson burn and Artist's Talent filling the deck with cheap fuel.

rows.bestPlan: Classic Jeskai Control: survive with cheap interaction and Inevitable Defeat, let Resonating Lute grind extra value while you sculpt, then end games with Jeskai Revelation at instant speed as a one-card refuel-and-kill.

decks.plan: Classic Jeskai Control: survive with cheap interaction and Inevitable Defeat, let Resonating Lute grind extra value while you sculpt, then end games with Jeskai Revelation at instant speed as a one-card refuel-and-kill.

Four-color Excruciator control: borrow Dimir's discard-and-removal core (Deceit, Requiting Hex, Bitter Triumph) to strip hands, use Resonating Lute and Inevitable Defeat to stabilize, and finish with either Doomsday Excruciator or a Jeskai Revelation that the opponent can no longer answer.

Jeskai Lessons tempo: a cheap-spell shell (Accumulate Wisdom, Combustion Technique, Firebending Lesson) powers Artist's Talent and Monument to Endurance, Resonating Lute turns the spell density into extra value, Inevitable Defeat clears blockers, and Revelation is the late-game haymaker that also refills the Monument engine.

Omniscience combo with a Jeskai finish: ramp with Resonating Lute and card selection into Kona or Formidable Speaker to cheat out Omniscience, then cast a free Jeskai Revelation (and Marang River Regent, North Wind Avatar) to draw the deck and burn the opponent out, with Inevitable Defeat buying time against aggro.
decks.colors: Five-color (Simic base splashing RW and B)

decks.plan: Jeskai Elementals midrange: Sunderflock and Winternight Stories generate board and cards, Burst Lightning, Lightning Helix and Inevitable Defeat control the early game, Resonating Lute provides a resilient value engine against removal-heavy decks, and Jeskai Revelation is the five-for-one that ends grindy mirrors.

decks.plan: The stock meta build: curve out with cheap dwarves, flood the board with Dáin's Company bodies, then push damage through with Practiced Offense, Warleader's Call anthems and burn to close before Prowess and Lessons stabilize.

Use Kíli's resource generation alongside Llanowar Elves and Badgermole Cub to ramp into Mightform Harmonizer and Ouroboroid, with Dáin's Company and Dwarven Mauler giving the landfall shell a wide board that Earthbender Ascension and Surrak turn into lethal.

An aristocrats take: Dáin's Company tokens and Kíli's treasures feed Marionette Apprentice and Vengeful Bloodwitch drain triggers while Duress, Bitter Triumph and Requiting Hex strip the opponent's interaction, so you win through attrition rather than combat.

A tempo-artifact build that treats Kíli's treasures as fuel for Gleaming Geardrake and Tablet of Discovery, backing a Dwarven Mauler beatdown with cantrips, Stormchaser's Talent and burn so the deck plays like Prowess with a sturdier, token-based board.

A midrange toolbox that slots the dwarves into the Gearhulk shell: Bloom Tender and Llanowar Elves accelerate into Brightglass Gearhulk, which tutors cheap dwarves and Seam Rip while Dáin's Company and Leatherhead provide a resilient board that grinds out Dimir and 4C Control.

rows.bestPlan: Golgari Scavenger Ramp: every Zealot sacrifice makes a Treasure plus a Scavenger's Talent Food, Pitiless Carnage and Fanatical Offering convert the fodder into cards, and the mana pile jumps you to Overlord of the Balemurk and Ouroboroid long before midrange decks can match it.

decks.plan: Stock Rakdos Sacrifice: Freebooter, Bloodghast and the Sackville-Bagginses feed Umbral Collar Zealot every turn while Marionette Apprentice and Sephiroth drain, and the Treasures ramp into Screaming Nemesis and cheap burn to close.

Orzhov Treasure Aristocrats: Bartolomé del Presidio and the Zealot turn Freebooter Treasures and Sackville-Baggins fodder into counters and drains, while the proven lifegain shell (Amalia, Starscape Cleric, Sanctifier) makes every sacrifice and Treasure trigger a lifegain payoff.

Golgari Scavenger Ramp: every Zealot sacrifice makes a Treasure plus a Scavenger's Talent Food, Pitiless Carnage and Fanatical Offering convert the fodder into cards, and the mana pile jumps you to Overlord of the Balemurk and Ouroboroid long before midrange decks can match it.

Dimir Treasure Excruciator: cheap black bodies plus the Zealot sac engine spit out Treasures so Doomsday Excruciator lands on turn four behind Duress and Requiting Hex, with Spyglass Siren and Kavaero smoothing draws and Stock Up finding the finisher.

Mardu Discard-Sacrifice: borrow the Bloodghast/Marauding Mako/Iron-Shield Elf discard core so Bitter Triumph and Cool but Rude discards recur fodder, then Freebooter, the Sackville-Bagginses and Zealot sacrifice it for Treasure and damage while Practiced Offense and Tersa push the aggro clock.

Golgari devotion ramp: mana dorks into Sentinel, Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos power out Storm the Festival and Cavalier of Thorns while Abrupt Decay and kicked Tear Asunder answer the artifacts, enchantments and threats a mono-green deck cannot touch.

Abzan Collected Company: the Selesnya creature package gains Sentinel as another premium three-drop CoCo hit, with a light black splash for Abrupt Decay and Tear Asunder to kill Cori-Steel Cutter, Stormchaser's Talent and opposing Enduring Innocence at instant speed.

Jund Sacrifice: Sentinel's Map tokens are artifacts to feed Deadly Dispute and Scavenger's Talent alongside the Oven-Cat engine, Mayhem Devil turns every sacrifice into damage, and Decay plus Tear Asunder clean up graveyard hate and opposing engines.

Sultai Bounce: the Dimir tempo shell of Hopeless Nightmare, Fear of Isolation and This Town Ain't Big Enough re-buys Sentinel for repeated Map triggers while its 3/4 vigilance body walls Prowess, and Abrupt Decay and Tear Asunder give the deck uncounterable answers to Cori-Steel Cutter, Talents and resolved bombs.

rows.bestPlan: The stock Izzet Prowess shell a tuned player would run: cheap prowess threats and Cori-Steel Cutter turn every Learn spell into a trigger, Igneous Inspiration is reach plus a rummage, and Combustion Technique / Abandon Attachments live in the sideboard as Lessons that Academic Dispute and Inspiration fetch as needed.

decks.plan: The stock Izzet Prowess shell a tuned player would run: cheap prowess threats and Cori-Steel Cutter turn every Learn spell into a trigger, Igneous Inspiration is reach plus a rummage, and Combustion Technique / Abandon Attachments live in the sideboard as Lessons that Academic Dispute and Inspiration fetch as needed.

Jeskai control that uses Professor of Symbology, Divide by Zero and Igneous Inspiration as a Learn engine to tutor the right Lesson (Combustion Technique for creatures, Abandon Attachments for tempo, Mascot Exhibition to close) while the UW permission and sweeper suite grinds the opponent out.

Boros Convoke go-wide with a Learn twist: Professor of Symbology and Guiding Voice are extra cheap bodies that fetch Combustion Technique or Expanded Anatomy, Igneous Inspiration clears blockers or finishes the game, and Knight-Errant plus Loxodon do the usual convoke swarming.

Grixis midrange that treats Learn as card quality: Thoughtseize and Push strip the early game, Eyetwitch and Igneous Inspiration dig for Combustion Technique or Abandon Attachments from the board, and Fable, Sheoldred and Unholy Annex are the inevitable top end that the Lessons protect.

Izzet Phoenix where Learn's discard-and-draw is the key: Igneous Inspiration and Academic Dispute pitch Arclight Phoenix while counting as spells for the recursion, Combustion Technique is a red Lesson that doubles as removal, and Abandon Attachments resets Picklock Prankster or Cori-Steel Cutter for more value.

Golgari midrange that plays a fair Tarmogoyf/Grist game but uses Plunge into Darkness as a life-for-cards engine, Children of Korlis to refund the life after a big Thud, and Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord as a repeatable on-board Thud that sacrifices Death's Shadow, Scavenging Ooze or Goyf for lethal drain.

Red-heavy prowess burn that lowers the opponent's life with Swiftspear, Slickshot, Bolt, Lava Dart and Bump in the Night so Scourge of the Skyclaves is enormous on both ends, then Mutagenic Growth, Plunge and Spoils shrink your own life for free Scourge power and Thud, Kazuul's Fury or Temur Battle Rage finish from any board state.

Dimir reanimator-combo where Spoils of the Vault tutors Goryo's Vengeance, Griselbrand's life-paying draws both refill the hand and grow Death's Shadow, and Thud flings Griselbrand or Archon of Cruelty (or a Shadow) for lethal the same turn, with Psychic Frog, Tainted Indulgence and Collective Brutality as discard outlets that also cost life.

decks.plan: Mardu Energy with a sacrifice twist: Eyetwitch and Stitcher's Supplier are 1-drops that pump Guide of Souls, mill Phlage for escape, and turn Goblin Bombardment and Flare of Malice into free edict-plus-discard with card selection from learn.

Grixis Persist reanimator: Supplier self-mills Archon of Cruelty for Persist, Unearth rebuys Supplier and Eyetwitch for more mills and loots, and Flare of Malice sacrifices Supplier at instant speed to mill three while edicting and stripping a card.

Golgari Yawgmoth combo: Eyetwitch and Supplier are cheap black bodies to feed Yawgmoth and Flare of Malice, Supplier mills Yawgmoth or Blood Artist for Agatha's Soul Cauldron, and undying creatures plus Chord of Calling assemble the drain kill.

Mono-black Aristocrats grind: recursive Gravecrawler and Bloodghast plus Eyetwitch and Supplier are endless Flare of Malice and Viscera Seer fodder, Marionette Apprentice and Bastion drain with every death, and a sideboard of Lessons (Pest Summoning, Necrotic Fumes, Introduction to Annihilation) gives Eyetwitch a toolbox.

Rakdos Asmo Food engine: Eyetwitch's learn and Underworld Cookbook discard Ovalchase Daredevil for value, Supplier mills Cauldron Familiar and Daredevil, Witch's Oven sacrifices Supplier and Eyetwitch for repeat triggers, and Flare of Malice eats a Familiar that just comes back.

A Hardened Scales shell where Fight Rigging is a Winding Constrictor that never dies to removal, every combat growing Ballista, Hangarback or Trudge until something hits 7 power and the hidden Walking Ballista or Craterhoof comes down free, with Turntimber Symbiosis dropping three counters onto any cheap artifact creature it finds.

Gruul midrange that leans on an escaped Phlage (6/6) or Slumbering Trudge needing just one Fight Rigging counter to reach 7 and unlock the hidden card, backed by Blood Moon to lock fair decks and Turntimber Symbiosis as a land that becomes a top-seven threat finder when games go long.

Amulet Titan already wants Turntimber Symbiosis as an untapped-able land, so this version adds Fight Rigging to push Primeval Titan (6/6) or Slumbering Trudge over 7 power and play the hidden card for free at combat, giving the deck a redundant explosive line through Spelunking and Scapeshift pressure.
decks.colors: Mono-Green with light Amulet Titan splashes (Gruul/Simic bounce lands)

decks.plan: A Sultai reanimator shell: Persist an Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, let Fight Rigging immediately counter away the -1/-1 and push to 7 power to flip the hidden card, while Turntimber Symbiosis acts as a second cheat effect that can put Archon straight into play from the top seven with Trudge as a hard-cast fallback.

decks.colors: R (Apex Devastator and Call Forth the Tempest only cast free via Technique/cascade)

decks.plan: Omni-Tell with a cascade engine: Show and Tell puts in Omniscience, then every card in hand is free, so Apex Devastator cascades four times into Technique, Call Forth the Tempest and more threats, while Stock Up, Brainstorm and Ponder dig and Force of Will/Daze protect the Show and Tell turn.

Food Chain plus Eternal Scourge or Squee makes infinite creature-only mana, which is exactly what a 10-mana creature wants: Fierce Empath tutors Apex Devastator, you hardcast it off Food Chain, and its four cascades chain into Call Forth the Tempest, Hullbreaker Horror and Tidespout Tyrant, with a cantrip/Force shell and Walking Ballista as the clean backup kill.

12 Post big mana: Cloudpost/Glimmerpost/Thespian's Stage/Vesuva with Candelabra, Crop Rotation, Expedition Map and Once Upon a Time make 10+ mana by turn three or four, so Apex Devastator is a hardcast cascade engine, Creative Technique cheats Ulamog/Emrakul, Primeval Titan and Green Sun's Zenith assemble the Posts, and free Furies and Endurance handle the creature and Reanimator decks.

decks.plan: Mono-blue High Tide where Call Forth the Tempest replaces Empty the Warrens-style finishes: High Tide plus Candelabra, Time Spiral and Turnabout generate storm counts of 10-15, so one Call Forth creates a dozen 4/4 fliers that laugh at Bowmasters and Fury, with Brain Freeze as the same-turn backup kill and Merchant Scroll/Mystical Tutor/Cunning Wish for consistency.

rows.bestPlan: The stock strong-player build: Grixis tempo that uses Buried Alive as a three-mana 'three Phoenixes in the yard' and then chains Bauble, Bolt, cantrips and Flow State to return a hasty 9 power while Force, Daze and Bolt hold the ground like Izzet Tempo does.

decks.plan: The stock strong-player build: Grixis tempo that uses Buried Alive as a three-mana 'three Phoenixes in the yard' and then chains Bauble, Bolt, cantrips and Flow State to return a hasty 9 power while Force, Daze and Bolt hold the ground like Izzet Tempo does.

Rakdos Reanimator where Buried Alive is a Dark Ritual-powered Entomb that finds Griselbrand or Archon plus Phoenixes, so Reanimate/Animate Dead give the turn-one fatty while the Phoenixes come back for free as a second threat axis that laughs at Swords and spot removal.

Jund Hollow Vine: Buried Alive bins Vengevines and Phoenixes, free or one-mana creatures (Hollow One, Gravecrawler, Stitcher's Supplier) and discard spells return Vengevine while Persist and cheap spells return Phoenix, overwhelming fair decks with recursive haste by turn two or three.

Rakdos Phoenix Storm: rituals, Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond are all cheap spells, so a turn-one Ritual into Buried Alive followed by Looting/Flow State/Gamble puts three hasty fliers on board, and the same engine pivots to Past in Flames, Empty the Warrens or Tendrils when Leyline or Deathrite hate shuts off the birds.

Dimir Tempo that never casts Arclight Phoenix at all: Buried Alive plus the Tamiyo/Bowmasters/Fatal Push disruption shell and a cantrip-heavy spell count let Phoenix return off Brainstorm, Ponder and Flow State while the deck keeps the full Force/Daze/Thoughtseize suite that is currently dominating the format.

rows.bestPlan: The stock-meta build: a Grixis control shell with Force of Will and the blue restricted list uses Sewer-veillance Cam and Thirst for Knowledge to bin Portal to Phyrexia or Sundering Titan, Goblin Welder swaps a spent Cam or Mox for the fatty, and Legion Extruder turns leftover baubles and moxen into 3/3 Golems that Welder immediately recycles back.

decks.plan: The stock-meta build: a Grixis control shell with Force of Will and the blue restricted list uses Sewer-veillance Cam and Thirst for Knowledge to bin Portal to Phyrexia or Sundering Titan, Goblin Welder swaps a spent Cam or Mox for the fatty, and Legion Extruder turns leftover baubles and moxen into 3/3 Golems that Welder immediately recycles back.

Mishra's Workshop prison that locks blue decks under Spheres and Chalice while Goblin Engineer and Cam stock the graveyard with Wurmcoil and Titan for Welder to cheat in, and Extruder converts dead Spheres into Golems once the lock has done its job.

A Lurrus-companion Boros grind deck where every permanent costs two or less: Baubles, Cam and Retrofitter servos are endless Extruder fodder, Welder re-welds them for repeat card draw, Lurrus rebuys Welder or Extruder when they die, and Swords plus Thalia hold off Frog and Initiative creatures.

Old-school Izzet Welder combo: Intuition and Thirst put Time Vault in the graveyard, Welder or Tezzeret bring it back, Manifold Key untaps it for infinite turns, while Cam filters toward the pieces and Extruder gives a fallback Golem beatdown against Null Rod hands.

Bazaar of Baghdad Hollow One shell: Bazaar, Looting and Cam discard Blightsteel, Portal or Wurmcoil into the yard for a turn-one or turn-two Welder, Hollow Ones come down free as both beaters and Extruder fodder, and Squee keeps the Bazaar discards free.

rows.bestPlan: The metagame-standard build: a Mono-White metalcraft weenie deck where Ancient Den, Clues from the Inspectors and Springleaf Drum turn Ardent Recruit and Auriok Sunchaser into cheap 3/3s, wide attacks make Search Party Captain a one-mana cantrip body, and Prismatic Strands plus Thraben Charm beat Madness and Affinity.

decks.plan: The metagame-standard build: a Mono-White metalcraft weenie deck where Ancient Den, Clues from the Inspectors and Springleaf Drum turn Ardent Recruit and Auriok Sunchaser into cheap 3/3s, wide attacks make Search Party Captain a one-mana cantrip body, and Prismatic Strands plus Thraben Charm beat Madness and Affinity.

Boros Rally Metalcraft: haste tokens from Rally at the Hornburg and Goblin Bushwhacker alongside Clockwork Percussionist and Epicure's Blood tokens let you swing with four bodies on turn two or three, cast Search Party Captain for a single W, and finish with Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt while Experimental Synthesizer and Drum keep metalcraft on.

Azorius Frogmite Affinity: artifact lands, Springleaf Drum and Clues power out free Frogmites, Myr Enforcers and Court Homunculus, Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor refill, Ardent Recruit is a one-mana 3/3 from turn one, and a swarm of cheap bodies attacking makes Search Party Captain a free cantrip while Metallic Rebuke and Counterspell protect the board.

Orzhov Artifact Midrange borrowing the Gardens engine: Clues, Blood Fountain, Ichor Wellspring and Treasures from Fanatical Offering keep three artifacts around so Ardent Recruit attacks as a 3/3 while you grind with Reckoner's Bargain, Tithing Blade and Cast Down, and Search Party Captain plus Kor Skyfisher rebuy value until the opponent runs out of answers.

Selesnya Drum Stompy: Elvish Mystic and Springleaf Drum let you deploy Ardent Recruit, Gingerbrute and Inspectors early, Rancor and Bonesplitter turn the metalcraft 3/3 and the unblockable Gingerbrute into fast clocks, Quirion Ranger untaps Drum-tapped creatures to keep attacking, and Search Party Captain plus Nyxborn Hydra give the deck gas and a mana sink in long games.

rows.bestPlan: Boros Madness that treats both Eidolons as free discard fodder for Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize, then gets them back every time Spirit Mascot resolves so the loot engine never runs out of cards to pitch while Fiery Temper and Bolt burn the opponent out.

decks.plan: Boros Synthesizer shell where Spirit Mascot is the multicolored spell that keeps re-buying chump-blocking or attacking Eidolons, with Kor Skyfisher bouncing the Mascot to recast it for repeat triggers while Bolt, Blast and Journey clear the way.

Boros Madness that treats both Eidolons as free discard fodder for Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize, then gets them back every time Spirit Mascot resolves so the loot engine never runs out of cards to pitch while Fiery Temper and Bolt burn the opponent out.

Mardu aristocrats that sacrifices Eidolons to Deadly Dispute, Carrion Feeder and Makeshift Munitions for value and reach, then rebuys them with Spirit Mascot, Terminate and Kathari Bomber so the sacrifice fodder is effectively infinite while the Gardens removal suite grinds out creature decks.

Boros Gates that uses Basilisk Gate and Citadel Gate to turn recursive Eidolons and the Mascot into huge attackers, with Sandstorm's can't-block ability pushing lethal through blockers and Aurora plus Prismatic Strands blanking burn and combat while Guardian of the Guildpact walls the ground.

Jeskai tempo that mills Eidolons with Thought Scour and Brainstorm, then uses Ninja of the Deep Hours and Kor Skyfisher to bounce and recast Spirit Mascot for repeat recursion, giving a Counterspell-and-Bolt control shell a steady stream of 2/2 Spirits that the opponent can never profitably remove.

rows.bestPlan: The stock Premodern build: discard clears counters, Buried Alive stacks Ashen Ghouls and Krovikan Horrors, and a turn-3/4 Living Death wipes the board (killing Dreadnoughts, Goblins and Terravores for free) while dropping a hasty-recursive army on an empty table.

decks.plan: The stock Premodern build: discard clears counters, Buried Alive stacks Ashen Ghouls and Krovikan Horrors, and a turn-3/4 Living Death wipes the board (killing Dreadnoughts, Goblins and Terravores for free) while dropping a hasty-recursive army on an empty table.

A permission deck that counters the opponent's threats, uses Intuition and Careful Study to pile Ashen Ghouls and Nether Spirits in the yard, and treats Living Death as a one-card Wrath plus reanimation that Psychatog and recursive attackers close out from.

A 187-creature midrange deck that grinds Sligh, Goblins and Madness with Flametongue Kavu, Nekrataal and Bone Shredder, strands Terrageddon and Standstill on mana with Avalanche Riders, then re-triggers every enter-the-battlefield effect at once with Living Death after a Pernicious Deed or trades.

Angry Hermit: a basic-less manabase lets Hermit Druid mill the entire library, then Living Death returns Krosan Cloudscraper, Symbiotic Wurm, Plaguelord and friends with haste from Anger (and flying from Wonder) for a one-turn kill, with discard protecting the combo against the blue decks.

Survival of the Fittest and Squee turn every card into a graveyard-filling tutor, so the deck plays a fair Spike/Hermit toolbox game until Living Death hits as a six-creature haymaker that returns Anger, Genesis-fed Baloths, Plaguelord and Deranged Hermit squirrels to lock the board.
